Package com.mendix.systemwideinterfaces.core

Interface IProfiler

public interface IProfiler
Interface which can be implemented to roll your own profiler for client requests. See "Profiling Module" in the AppStore for more information.

  • Method Details

    • enterRuntime

      default Object enterRuntime(String sessionId, String requestId, String userName, Set<String> userRoles, String jsonRequest, Long now)
      Method that is called upon handling a new request in the runtime.
      Parameters:
      sessionId - the session identifier of the request
      requestId - the identifier of the request
      userName - the name of the user that made the request
      userRoles - the security roles of the user that made the request
      jsonRequest - the JSON content of the request as a String
      now - the timestamp of the request (in milliseconds since the Unix epoch)
      Returns:
      some object that will be passed to the corresponding finishRuntime(java.lang.Object, java.lang.Long)

    • finishRuntime

      default void finishRuntime(Object logObject, Long now)
      Method that is called upon finishing a request in the runtime.
      Parameters:
      logObject - the object that was returned by the corresponding enterRuntime(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.util.Set<java.lang.String>, java.lang.String, java.lang.Long)
      now - the timestamp of the end of the request (in milliseconds since the Unix epoch)

    • enterDatabase

      default Object enterDatabase(String sessionId, String requestId, String requestData, Long now)
      Method that is called upon issuing a new query to the database.
      Parameters:
      sessionId - the session identifier of the session for which the query is made
      requestId - the identifier of the request for which the query is made
      requestData - the SQL statement that is sent to the database
      now - the timestamp of the request (in milliseconds since the Unix epoch)
      Returns:
      some object that will be passed to the corresponding finishDatabase(java.lang.Object, java.lang.Long)

    • finishDatabase

      default void finishDatabase(Object logObject, Long now)
      Method that is called upon finishing a query on the database.
      Parameters:
      logObject - the object that was returned by the corresponding enterDatabase(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.Long)
      now - the timestamp of the query result (in milliseconds since the Unix epoch)
